items.scope: Introduction, related work, preliminaries and compatibility geometry, pp.1–8, AppendixA pp.33–34
items.checks: Read all definitions, quantile argument, compatibility compositions and fixed Gram isometry. Positive definiteness assumed in Section4; dependent families require quotient interpretation at the general semidefinite level. External optimal transport results used conditionally.

items.scope: APGD, SPGD, Frank–Wolfe and constraints, pp.9–12; AppendixB p.35
items.checks: Exact C2 example meeting Theorem4.2 domain assumptions produces a two-cycle and violates its explicit bound. An actual Gaussian-KL extrapolation also leaves the cone and exceeds the asserted smoothness bound, but no KL divergence/nonconvergence counterexample claimed. SPGD proof drops nonzero constrained-optimum gradient; supplied projection-fixed-point repair retains conditional rate. Frank–Wolfe compact-domain assumptions read.

items.scope: Mean-field existence, self-consistency, curvature and transport regularity, pp.13–17; AppendixC1 pp.36–38
items.checks: Open convex Gaussian family disproves unrestricted existence in Lemma5.1. Tracked well-conditioning, product marginal self-consistency and Monge–Ampere differentiation through third derivative. No contradiction found to the stated derivative bounds under their assumptions; external contraction and concentration inputs not independently reproved.

Read linear ramps, Gaussian truncation and mesh scaling. Higher-order constraints(24) admit nonmonotone maps: explicit two-cell negative derivative; repair by every prefix constraint. This does not disprove existence of the specially constructed approximant. Tracked KL conversion, product-stationarity needed for zero first variation, and strong-convexity distance estimate.

items.scope: Smoothness and deterministic algorithm, pp.19–21; AppendixC4 pp.43–45
items.checks: Checked potential and entropy Hessians, alpha lower derivative bound, centered translation block Q+I, derivative Gram bound Upsilon and weighted conditional cell variance. Upsilon bound is distinct from invalid uniform leverage Xi bound. Theorem5.12 inherits an unaddressed APGD extrapolation-domain issue.

items.scope: Stochastic algorithm and complexity, pp.21–23; AppendixC5 pp.45–47
items.checks: Exact entropy and one potential-gradient sample assumptions read; no translations in theorem. Covariance bounded by second moments, mean-field gradient variance derivation and conditional Xi-dependent rate tracked. Analytic Gaussian-tail leverage lower bound contradicts uniform Xi<=CJ^2, so stated dictionary-specific corollary is not justified. No actual SGD complexity lower bound claimed.

items.scope: Experiments and implementation, pp.23–25; AppendixD pp.48–49
items.checks: Read all experimental settings and figures. Mixture/logistic tests outside strong log-concavity noted. Gaussian KL constant sign and invalid Bernoulli recipe directly checked. Covariance distance is a lower-bound diagnostic, not full distributional convergence verification.
